title: Two-point swap equivalence gives no literal containment
situation: Source points are {a}, target points {b}, and the forward and backward maps swap the two carrier elements.
attempted_conclusion: Infer literal source-to-target containment from mapped equivalence.

expected.reason: Both map directions and inverses hold, but a is not a target point.

sources.anchor: def onlyA_onlyB_equiv : MappedEquivalence onlyA onlyB where
theorem onlyA_not_refines_onlyB : Not (Refines onlyA onlyB) := by
